findings.finding: C14 preliminary scenario names senior representative as candidate without primary-handler distinction; case policy explicitly reserves sealed export, close and member disclosure to primary handler and caps collaborator powers.
findings.correction: Primary-handler positive case; supervisor-only, collaborator and role-only negatives; test privileged classification independently. Refusal returns no protected bytes, creates no business effect and no success audit; retain required denial/security audit.

findings.finding: OCR view/download authority does not imply processing authority; unlinked member uploader policy defaults to not adopted.
findings.correction: Separate explicit canProcessOcr or kernel action, adopted own-upload policy, classification ceiling, version binding and distinct reviewer from basic document access.

findings.finding: Representation protocol draft/display default is not executable; save invalidates approval; different administrator must approve. Existing generic action ledger lacks explicit adoption and self-approval refusal.
findings.correction: Add protocol read/save/approval and stale/self approval refusal as authority dependency of C05/C08/C09/C10/C19; do not manufacture institutional approval.

findings.finding: All 14 scheduled source jobs have matching POST keys in the historical HTTP manifest, including base-operations-monitor. This exact join does not establish the complete live-source tree, provider callbacks, actual configured jobs or runtime execution.
findings.correction: Preserve this successful static schedule-to-manifest join; independently rebuild the route tree, server actions, callbacks and deployed schedule inventory before sealing.

findings.finding: Registry marks billing-lifecycle cron NOT_IMPLEMENTED, but canonical scheduler includes it and the actual POST handler invokes platform-economics billing automation under cron authentication and live distinct-approver mandates. This is a verified source-level registry contradiction, not runtime proof or authorization to bill.
findings.correction: Reconcile registry wording in a separate admitted application change after service and runtime review. Preserve separation of commercial subscription billing from excluded union finance; verify missing/inactive/expired/self-approved mandates, retry reservation, no duplicate invoice effects, and actual schedule profile. Never trigger real billing for this review.

findings.finding: External matter and document grants require separate identity/authority/grant/permission evaluation and document version. WorkAid specialist activation remains deferred, but existing union-side and external routes need explicit disposition.
findings.correction: Map external authority truth table: missing/expired/revoked/mismatched matter/document/representative org, version and consent; verify positive path only if admitted.

findings.finding: Historical caller inventory explicitly says full mutating-caller denominator not established; 86 server actions needing explicit fixtures listed at that snapshot.
findings.correction: Regenerate current HTTP + server-action + worker + provider-callback + service-caller inventories and reconcile one by one; no reliance on route-method total alone.

findings.finding: Role source and authorization contracts do not establish enabled institution-specific office, mandate, capacity or active representation protocol combinations.
findings.correction: Build actual tenant fixture protocol and capacity explicit matrix; distinguish denial requirement from positive admission.
